title: [Educational Tutorial] 16-Part Smart Money Concepts (SMC) Institutional Masterclass Directory & Tribute to the TradingView Platform

selftext:
Fellow traders and technical craftsmen,

Over the past few weeks, we systematically deconstructed modern market microstructure across 16 in-depth educational tutorials published directly on TradingView—translating interbank order flow, algorithmic price delivery (IPDA), and mathematical risk geometry into an actionable, empirical curriculum.

Today, we officially published the \*\*Master Architectural Index & Directory\*\* on TradingView. This serves as a complete, permanent syllabus and navigation hub connecting all 16 episodes:

🔗 \*\*Complete Master Directory on TradingView:\*\*

\### 🗺️ Curriculum Overview (100% Free on TradingView):

\*\*Phase 1: Algorithmic Delivery & Core Market Geometry\*\*

\* \*\*Ep 01:\*\* The IPDA Algorithm & London Judas Swing (Buying below 00:00 EST Midnight Open)

\* \*\*Ep 02:\*\* Strong vs. Weak Swings & The Algorithmic Draw on Liquidity (DOL)

\* \*\*Ep 03:\*\* Internal Structure (iBOS) vs. Macro BOS Trend Traps

\* \*\*Ep 04:\*\* Trend Continuation (BOS) vs. True Reversals (Displacement CHoCH / MSS)

\*\*Phase 2: Liquidity Engineering & Imbalances\*\*

\* \*\*Ep 05:\*\* Liquidity Engineering — Equal Highs/Lows & Inducement (IDM) Bait

\* \*\*Ep 06:\*\* Order Block Anatomy & The 50% Mean Threshold (MT) Invalidation

\* \*\*Ep 07:\*\* Imbalance Dynamics — Fair Value Gaps, BPR & Inversion IFVGs (50% CE)

\* \*\*Ep 08:\*\* Dealing Range Equilibrium & The 70.5% OTE Centroid

\*\*Phase 3: Precision Execution & Microstructure Models\*\*

\* \*\*Ep 09:\*\* Breaker Blocks, Mitigation Flips & Propulsion Launchpads

\* \*\*Ep 10:\*\* Micro-Zone Refinement (Slashing Stop-Loss Size by 75%)

\* \*\*Ep 11:\*\* Time Precedes Price — Session Killzones, 20m Macros & CBDR Bands

\* \*\*Ep 12:\*\* Inter-Market SMT Cracks, Silver Bullet & Market Maker Models (MMBM/MMSM)

\*\*Phase 4: Quantitative Execution & Risk Geometry\*\*

\* \*\*Ep 13:\*\* The Quantitative 6-Step Multi-Timeframe Execution Funnel

\* \*\*Ep 14:\*\* Asymmetric Trade Geometry, Expected Value (EV) & Fractional Kelly Sizing

\* \*\*Ep 15:\*\* Forensic Autopsy of Retail SMC Traps (Premium Buying & False POIs)
